{{for|Perrin's sister|Adora Aybara}}
'''Adora Aybara''' is the granddaughter of [[Perrin Aybara]] and [[Faile Bashere]] in a potential future seen by [[Rand al'Thor]].

== History ==
In one potential future, Rand sees the Two Rivers ruled by Lady Adora Aybara, who is the Mayor of [[Emond's Field]] in her time. She has both Two Rivers features from her grandfather and [[Saldaea]]n features from her grandmother. However, this is one of many futures seen by Rand when he battles the [[Dark One]], and it is unclear whether Adora will truly be born in the [[Fourth Age]].
